draft.goal: Verify bounded real-Windows progressive JPEG decode capability for WIC/GDI+ using independently validated multi-scan fixtures, canonical differential comparison and fail-closed malformed classification, without authorizing decoder adoption, absolute correctness for all JPEGs, or product policy changes.

tasks.goal: Implement and measure the W9 progressive JPEG matrix under DC-MP-IMG2 without changing product decode policy.

inputs.description: Full caller-selected W9 directive: docs/development/evidence-published/img2-w9-latest/tern-next-directive.txt (verbatim 1615 lines). All constraints and acceptance below are projections of it.
MP-IMG1/MP-SEC3 completion; MP ss19.55-.61; DC-MP-IMG2 and media admission; BUILD_AND_RUN 4.23-4.28; TESTING; ADR-0009/0012. W8 limited completion does not satisfy MP-IMG3.
Reuse the W8 JPEG fixtures/parser/matrix/verifier, wic_probe.ps1, gdiplus_probe.ps1, W2 worker and W6 sampler. No probe, product decoder, dependency or Runtime change.

constraints.text: Use DC-MP-IMG2 under ADR-0009/0012 only. Start 870cd2749c5e6b76b370ab48049f29854b4f6af8 on dev. Preserve W1-W8 source, native, Gate and review bytes; no push, main or release.
Five fixed sources: progressive grayscale 256 and 1024 with non-uniform content, two derived malformed progressives and one accepted W8 baseline control. At most ten decoder legs.
Emit a real SOF2 multi-scan stream from a minimal in-repo encoder: one initial DC scan and one initial AC scan with valid spectral selection and byte stuffing. Do not claim refinement-scan support.

Validate SOF2, scan count, SOS selectors, Ss/Se, Ah/Al, entropy bounds, stuffing, EOI and trailing bytes from the encoded bytes; a SOF2 marker alone is not validity, and entropy content stays NOT_VERIFIED.
Keep differential and absolute verification separate; malformed decoder success is never promoted to content verification; progressive differential is never absolute correctness.

W9 experimental limits: dimension 2048, 4,194,304 pixels, 8 bits per channel, 16 MiB decoded/scratch/encoded, 32 MiB output, 256 MiB work root, 8 MiB report, 128 records/128 KiB trace, 64 KiB capture, 45 s worker, 300 s batch, one worker, 5 sources, 10 legs.
Ship a fail-closed verifier and exercise all 40 required mutation classes through verify(); structural replay keeps source_identity_verified=false and closure_eligible=false.
Stop and record DESIGN_BLOCKED, AUTHORITY_BLOCKED, DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED, SAFETY_BLOCKED, NOT_RUN, NOT_MEASURED or NOT_VERIFIED instead of inventing an unapproved design, tolerance or decoder adoption.

outputs.description: Deterministic W6 fixtures, repeated process sampler/matrix, independent fail-closed verifier and focused tests.
Bounded Windows matrix, raw sample series, source/executable identities, cohort comparisons, arithmetic, independent raster proof and explicit measurement limitations.
Local quality and historical regression outcomes; pinned same-candidate Quality/Build receipts, artifact bytes, retention, complete Tern review and limited disposition.

acceptance.statement: New W9 SOURCE and Taskern packet are fixed before Native execution.
Progressive fixtures regenerate deterministically and expose valid multi-scan SOF2 structure with DC and AC scans.
WIC and GDI+ both decode the progressive sources and their canonical RGBA is compared on every pixel.
Differential agreement is never reported as absolute correctness.
Malformed progressive inputs never reach content verification in either candidate.
Full-frame admission, output publication and the stop contract are preserved.
All 40 negative mutation classes are rejected by the real verifier.
W8 JPEG regressions and W1-W7 historical replays pass unchanged.
New workspace, IMG2 replay, W9 quality and build Gates succeed on the same candidate with matching artifacts and raw receipts.
A complete Tern review returns 0/0/0 while entropy, refinement, allocation and product boundaries stay unmeasured.

evaluation.requirement: Actual bounded Windows WIC and GDI+ progressive execution plus independent marker, multi-scan, canonical differential and mutation verification that preserves every missing or failing fact.
Actual Taskern prepare, unchanged local/feature/R0/W1-W8 checks, new same-candidate Gates with raw receipts, privacy-reviewed Tern packages and complete 0/0/0.
